findings.label: hset:sf:lem:persist
findings.original: if $\Sigma$ is recursive, so is the second theory.
findings.counterexample: S=T=Th(N), identity interpretations, Sigma empty; T is not computably axiomatizable.
findings.correction: Assume T has a computably enumerable axiom set, Sigma is computably enumerable, and the interpretation translation is computable; then the extension is computably axiomatizable. Dovetail both axiom enumerations.
findings.impact: Generic lemma only; the actual finite-language ZFC/class applications already have effective source axiomatizations and computable fixed-formula translations.
Provenance metadata only; merged372+151=523 and all old labels preserved.
